settings._yearMax_note: Policy decision 2026-07-27: no year gate. We never republish text — the corpus is private input for reference extraction and the frontend only links out — so we download whatever archive.org freely serves as _djvu.txt (lending-restricted items have no such file and are skipped naturally).

collections.name: Matthew Henry — Commentary on the Whole Bible
collections.query: creator:(henry, matthew) AND title:(commentary OR exposition) AND mediatype:texts
